news.title: Delhi: NDMC unlikely to roll out unit area property tax system this fiscal
news.para: Property tax reforms by the New Delhi Municipal Council are currently stalled this financial year, much to the frustration of traders grappling with high tax bills based on unrealistic rental values. The central government’s green light and gazette notification for the unit area method, which aims to standardize property tax assessments, remain unresolved, indicating a protracted implementation process.

news.title: MiC approves property tax framework for unauthorized colonies in Indore
news.para: The Mayor-in-Council has given the green light for property tax reforms aimed at residents with legitimate ownership documents. In addition, significant infrastructure projects and public-private partnerships were sanctioned. A new link road will connect Kanadia Road to Khajrana Temple, improving traffic conditions. Plans have also been set for new commercial markets in Subhash Nagar and Vallabh Nagar.

news.title: Ahmedabad civic body suspends development permission of Bodakdev high-rise over TOZ eligibility
news.para: The Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation has suspended the development approval for a high-rise due to doubts about its compliance with Transit Oriented Zone regulations. Initially sanctioned with an excessive Floor Space Index, the project is now under scrutiny. Officials are insisting on a complete re-assessment of its TOZ eligibility, leading to ongoing suspension of development activities until verification is complete.

news.title: Nagpur civic body to freeze bank accounts, seize TVs & fridge of property tax defaulters
news.para: The Nagpur Municipal Corporation is gearing up for an assertive property tax collection initiative. To recover outstanding dues, the civic body plans to freeze bank accounts and seize properties of those who default on payments. This crucial recovery operation will focus on collecting substantial arrears from local businesses, with teams deployed throughout the city. Citizens are advised to address their tax obligations promptly to evade penalties.

news.title: Pay house tax in three instalments, Prayagraj civic body offers full interest waiver
news.para: Prayagraj Municipal Corporation has launched a one-time settlement scheme for house tax dues. This initiative offers a complete waiver on accumulated interest for property owners. Eligible individuals can pay their principal house tax in up to three installments. The scheme aims to encourage settlement of long-pending property tax liabilities. Property owners can apply through zonal offices or the municipal corporation website.

news.title: Four buildings in Gurugram DLF phase-III sealed for 'unauthorised construction'
news.para: Four buildings were sealed in Gurugram for unauthorized construction and commercial activities.  Unused stilt areas were demolished, and illegal PGs and guest houses were sealed.  Approximately 1.5 kilometers of the Right of Way was cleared of encroachments.  The enforcement wing of the Town and Country Planning Department led the drive.  District Town Planner Amit Madholiya oversaw the operations.

news.title: Gujarat: Housing loan ticket size up 72%, takers decline 28% in Q1 FY27
news.para: In Gujarat, a trend is emerging in the housing market where fewer buyers are opting for home loans. Those who do are securing larger amounts, a reflection of the soaring property and construction costs in the region. Meanwhile, affluent buyers are still acquiring bigger homes, while the mass market grapples with rising prices that have made affordability a significant challenge.

news.title: Gurugram's paperless services under review as land mutation, registration backlogs mount
news.para: Gurugram is currently grappling with a notable backlog in its digital land services, with many cases pending for mutations and registrations. Additionally, the digital crop survey is burdened by numerous unapproved surveys. Authorities have been instructed to hasten the resolution of these outstanding departmental matters. User engagement is vital to addressing cases that require citizen cooperation. Revenue officials are responsible for providing timely and transparent services to enhance citizen experience.

news.title: Builders line up to buy bankrupt developers as land prices rise
news.para: Small and mid-sized developers are increasingly using insolvency proceedings to acquire distressed real estate companies as land prices soar in major cities. With projects, development rights and urban assets on offer, NCLT-approved deals are rising, but buyers face risks involving titles, approvals, litigation, liabilities and stalled project execution.

news.title: Maharashtra government approves ₹17,725 crore Mumbai metro line 13
news.para: The Maharashtra government has given the green light to Metro Line 13, which will link Mira-Bhayandar to Vasai-Virar. Spanning 25 kilometers, the project is expected to exceed Rs 17,700 crore. Additionally, Rs 10,500 crore has been allocated for the expansion of Pune Ring Road, aimed at improving traffic circulation around Pune and significantly cutting down travel time.

news.title: Goldman Sachs to buy LCN Capital Partners in up to $410 million deal
news.para: Goldman Sachs is set to enhance its real estate operations with the acquisition of LCN Capital Partners for a total of $410 million. This strategic investment, scheduled to be concluded by the end of 2026, consists of a mix of initial and performance-based stock payments. LCN's focus on sale-leaseback and net-lease investments makes this acquisition particularly relevant in today's evolving market.

news.title: US housing market remains under pressure in July; factory output rises
news.para: Single-family housing starts declined significantly in July, reaching their lowest rate since November 2022.  Permits for future single-family construction, however, saw a modest increase last month.  Meanwhile, US factory output reached its highest level in over four years.  This manufacturing growth was driven by strong demand for high-tech equipment and AI investment.  Defense sector production also contributed to the factory output gains amid ongoing global conflicts.

news.title: Sakarni Plaster targets ₹1,000 crore turnover by FY27, plans ₹450 crore expansion push
news.para: Sakarni Plaster is aiming for a massive ₹1,000 crore turnover by fiscal year 2027. This ambitious growth is fueled by a substantial ₹450 crore investment plan. These funds will be strategically deployed for expanding production capacity, introducing exciting new products, and broadening their market reach geographically, as revealed by chairman and managing director Ashok Gupta.

news.title: GT Bharathi to develop a WTC in Chengalpattu, as part of its ₹7,000 crore mixed-use project
news.para: Chennai developer GT Bharathi will build a World Trade Center business park. This integrated IT-centric township will span approximately 150 acres. The project includes commercial, retail, and residential spaces, and data centers. It is designed to create over 100,000 jobs and foster global connections. Chengalpattu's strategic location supports this significant economic development initiative.

news.title: Thane civic body proposes steep property tax hike of 12-20%
news.para: The Thane Municipal Corporation plans to raise property taxes significantly. Homeowners will face a 12% increase, while businesses may see hikes as steep as 20%. The intention behind this tax revision is to boost the civic body’s financial standing, although it still falls short of closing the current revenue shortfall. Numerous residents have voiced their discontent, labeling the increase as unfair.

news.title: Firm linked to LNJ Bhilwara buys Max Group apartment in Noida for ₹37 crore
news.para: A luxury apartment in Noida sold for thirty-seven crore rupees. This transaction highlights growing demand for managed communities and prime locations. Max Estates acquired a project with significant development potential. The developer expects substantial revenue from fresh sales and existing customers. Noida is becoming a premium real estate destination for executives.

news.title: Haryana clarifies stamp duty waiver on family property transfers covering daughter's children
news.para: Haryana state has provided clear guidelines regarding stamp duty exemptions for family property transfers. Now, exemptions extend to grandchildren inherited through daughters, addressing previous ambiguities. A corrigendum issued to a 2014 notification brings clarity to all citizens, ensuring property registry offices can operate without confusion. This amendment simplifies property transfer for families, eliminating potential tax conflicts when dealing with grandkids.

news.title: SC asks CBI to examine all six allegations of dubious transactions involving Indiabulls Housing
news.para: The Supreme Court has directed the CBI to probe six allegations against Indiabulls Housing Finance Limited. The Enforcement Directorate initially raised concerns about these questionable transactions. The CBI will now thoroughly investigate five aspects already reviewed by Delhi Police, while a special court in Mumbai is set to evaluate its application regarding Rs 1,575 crore.

news.title: Senior living supply may rise to one lakh units by 2030: Report
news.para: India’s organised senior living inventory is currently around 25,000 units and may increase to about one lakh units by 2030, according to Colliers India. Developers, operators and investors have announced investments of over ₹13,000 crore since 2025 for senior living projects.

news.title: ASK Property Fund exits Shriram Properties’ Chennai project for ₹340 crore
news.para: ASK Property Fund has exited its investment in Shriram 122 West, a residential project by Shriram Properties in Chennai. The fund realised ₹340 crore on an investment of ₹215 crore, delivering about 1.6 times gross investment multiple.
